question: How many movies are in the database?

question: What movies were released in 1994?
expected_sql: SELECT title FROM movies WHERE release_year = 1994;

question: Which movie has the longest runtime?
expected_sql: SELECT title FROM movies ORDER BY runtime DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which movie has the shortest runtime?
expected_sql: SELECT title FROM movies ORDER BY runtime ASC LIMIT 1;

expected_sql: SELECT title FROM movies WHERE language = 'Japanese';

question: Which movies did Christopher Nolan direct?
expected_sql: SELECT m.title FROM movies m JOIN movie_directors md ON m.movie_id = md.movie_id JOIN directors d ON md.director_id = d.director_id WHERE d.name = 'Christopher Nolan';
expected_result: The Dark Knight, Inception, Interstellar, Oppenheimer, Tenet, Dunkirk, Memento

question: Which actors appeared in Inception?
expected_sql: SELECT a.name FROM actors a JOIN movie_actors ma ON a.actor_id = ma.actor_id JOIN movies m ON ma.movie_id = m.movie_id WHERE m.title = 'Inception';
expected_result: Leonardo DiCaprio, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Elliot Page
